answer: Because the relic stake is held until the ledge settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the jetty audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 15% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A farm running 32 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
